records.region: Arica y Parinacota, northern Chile: Tignamar approach, Azapa valley and Arica Pacific coast.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Río San José is the supported receiving-system identity through the middle/lower valley and Arica coastal ending. The selected upstream course is Río Tignamar. The names coexist as distinct reaches; no single hydronym or exact transition vertex is imposed on every selected part.
records.completion_scope: All 28 selected parts correspond at ordinary corridor scale: the chosen Río Tignamar opening and joins, Río Seco confluence, receiving Río San José/Azapa valley, Arica urban continuation and actual Pacific terminal. IGM and independent municipal originals provide complementary coverage; the unavailable optional book is not required.
records.supported_name_scope: Río San José is the supported receiving-system identity through the middle/lower valley and Arica coastal ending. The selected upstream course is Río Tignamar. The names coexist as distinct reaches; no single hydronym or exact transition vertex is imposed on every selected part.

scope_limits: The representative system identity does not turn the distinct Río Tignamar reach into a uniform Río San José scalar label. Formal registry and Korean naming remain unverified.
Correspondence is at ordinary river-corridor and city/coastal scale, not exact banks, present shoreline coordinates, present wetness or a surveyed source point.
The selected coastal reach is independently depicted through the urban corridor. Neither a continuously wet outlet nor a present wetland boundary is inferred.
No operational inventory of irrigation intakes, off-route transfers or minor impoundments is established. These do not require an unsupported through-link in the continuously depicted selected river.
The optional biodiversity book supplied no substantive original evidence after two completed HTTP502 responses; the finding does not depend on its discovery excerpts.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
